description_for_human: Automatically routes your question to the optimal LLM model based on its complexity — no manual model selection needed.
description_for_model: Use query-oracle to route any user query to the right LLM model and effort level automatically. Call routeQuery for a full response, or classifyQuery to preview the routing decision without executing a model call. The router returns tier (fast/balanced/deep), model_used, cost_usd, and the answer.
